entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Hello? I... I need some help with an order, please.
Hi there, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. I can definitely help you today. To get started, could I get your name and order number?
It's Sarah Gable. The order number is VF-881-209. I'm calling about the Aero Road Helmet I bought. I'm just so disappointed.

Okay, Sarah, I've pulled up your order for the Aero Road Helmet. I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, no, there's nothing wrong with it. It's just... the color. It looked different online, and now it just sits there. The box is unopened and everything. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I really, really needed that money back for bills this month.
I understand completely. Sometimes the way a color appears on screen isn't quite the same in person. Let me just check our return policy for you. One moment.
Okay... I hope you can help. It's a lot of money to have tied up in something I won't use.

Alright, Sarah, I've got good news. Looking at your delivery date, you are well within our 90-day return window for the helmet. Since the box is unopened, we can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful! I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. Thank you so much, Alex.

You're very welcome. It's important to us that you're happy with your gear, especially something as critical as a helmet where fit and comfort are key to your safety. I've just emailed you a prepaid return shipping label. Just attach that to the box and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
That is such a relief. You've really made my day. I'll get that sent back this afternoon. Thank you again!
Happy to help, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
